title: Do you think this picture is ai or real?
author: Present-Syrup-2270
selftext:
Only 37% of the people got it right, do you think you can do better?

I noticed that everyone around me was very confident about being able to detect fake ai pics, and that got me wondering if that was really true. So being the curious ai gamemaker i am lol, i made a simple game (https://isthis-ai.pages.dev/en/) where you can guess whether a picture is made by ai or not and put your sharp eye to the test. Also there is a survival mode where the game goes on until you miss, and so far nobody's gone beyond 11. 

Can you guys beat that score? Only one way to find out lol. Let's see who's got the sharpest eye here!
